subject: Can't get ggplot transparency on R-3.1.0

messages.author: 61221ab1f726dce8
messages.subject: Can't get ggplot transparency on R-3.1.0
parts:
Hi all,

I recently upgraded to R-3.1.0 from R-3.0.2. Things seem to be fine, but when trying to plot a ggplot image with transparency, I get the following issue:

library('ggplot2')
df <- data.frame(cond = factor( rep(c("A","B"), each=200) ), rating = c(rnorm(200),rnorm(200, mean=.8)))
ggplot(df, aes(x=rating, fill=cond)) + geom_density(alpha=.3)

Warning message:
In grid.Call.graphics(L_polygon, x$x, x$y, index) :
  semi-transparency is not supported on this device: reported only once per page

My old R-3.0.2 has no issues. Only the R-3.1.0. Does anyone have any ideas what may have happened? I am using CentOS release 5.5 (Final) if that information helps.

Thanks,
